label: BL
reason: User input from Referer header flows via doSomething to bar which is used in response.getWriter().format(bar, ...), potentially causing XSS. However, doSomething applies a replace operation that removes characters based on length checks against 'Z'. While this logic appears incomplete for full sanitization, it acts as a specific filter rather than a clearly bypassed guard. Reviewers may disagree whether this constitutes a real exploitable vulnerability (TP) or an acceptable control (FP) depending on interpretation of the replace semantics.

evidence.note: Input from Referer header decoded and passed to doSomething, then written to response via format; doSomething modifies input based on length check.
